text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Debt-ridden Perwaja Steel Sdn Bhd has shown a marked imporvement in productivity and efficiency, since the interim management of Maju Holdings took over, said Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim
-- Malaysian Airlines will undertake its largest-ever capital raising exercise to gross 3.27 billion ringgit partly to finance its fleet rationalisation and expansion programme.
-- Malaysia sees Singapore's former Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew's remarks seeking a normalisation of ties between the countries as positive, said Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.
